question: How many trips went from JFK Airport to Times Sq/Theatre District?
note: ground truth: SELECT SUM(trip_count) FROM zone_pair_flows WHERE pickup_zone='JFK Airport' AND dropoff_zone='Times Sq/Theatre District'. KNOWN GAP as of this eval: QueryPlan's 'flow' metric only resolves an origin-area filter (query_plan.py CANONICAL_FIELDS has one 'area' slot per metric, no destination field), so the compiled SQL drops the 'to Times Sq' half of the question and sums all destinations from JFK instead -- expect this to legitimately fail against the live system today.

question: How many trips were picked up in zone 161 in total?
note: ground truth: SELECT SUM(total_trips) FROM zone_hourly_demand WHERE pickup_location_id=161 (zone 161 = Midtown Center). KNOWN GAP as of this eval: sql_agent.py's QueryPlan JSON schema always types 'area' as a JSON string, but nyc_schema.py's demand metric maps area to the numeric pickup_location_id column (is_text=False); query_plan_compiler._sql_literal rejects a string value for a numeric column, so ANY area-filtered demand-metric question raises an uncaught ValueError -- expect this call to error, not just mismatch.
